decisions.reason: As a low-cost, ecosystem-building extension of the core business that is still prominently shown, it preserves learning and partnership options even though its direct commercial fit is less certain than the firm's plant products.

Because it remains on its own page and is described as a strategic focus, management would likely keep this option open while market and technical uncertainty continue to resolve around a potentially high-upside circular-material application.

This flagship product is very close to the firm's core waste-treatment machinery capabilities and is still highlighted on the home page, so the option value of staying in the market is high and the case for abandonment is weak.
